argv: All 69 live neurons are clean a+b Fourier (single k, phase_out~=pa+pb, |err|<0.35) over 34 freqs; 59 dead neurons stay dead. fc2.bias is saturated at +-1 and is NOT noise: corr 0.92 with -(W2 @ mean h), i.e. it cancels per-class DC offsets; residual class-mean logit std 0.52 that the bias can't reach (zeroing it hurt: trial peak 84.8 -> 81.8 at +1000). Some fc2 'sign errors' also encode this offset compensation. Edit: 749 entries (458 fc1, 291 fc2) whose sign disagreed with the neuron's own best-fit cosine (|cos|>0.08), largest deviation first, set to clip(1.3cos,+-0.88); no resets. Trial +1000: 79.8 -> peak 85.9 at +300 -> 82.4 at +1000, declining ~0.5%/100 steps (optimizer re-memorizes). Alternative (643 fc1 flips + 1 dead neuron revived as constant bias unit with fc2 col = -class offset) peaked 84.6, ended 81.2. All 3 trials show peak at +200-300 then decline.
